one_line: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, wikis, and databases.
auth_notes: Three auth models: internal connections (static API token, single workspace), public connections (OAuth 2.0, security review only for Marketplace listing), and personal access tokens (user-scoped bearer token).
self_serve_notes: Free personal plan; any developer can create an internal integration or PAT in the Notion developer portal without approval.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Pages, databases, views, comments, users, search, file uploads, data sources — nearly everything in a workspace.
api_surface.webhook_note: Connections can subscribe to webhook events (page/property updates, new comments) per the webhooks guide.

existing_mcp.note: Official Notion MCP server exists (notion-io/notion-mcp-server); community servers also exist.

evidence.note: Fetched 'Using Notion API' overview confirms all three auth models, capabilities, and webhook support.

agent_notes: Internal integration must be explicitly granted page/database access in the workspace.
